page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 16 vCPUs derived from 8 dedicated physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, alongside 62.0 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance operates without bundled local storage and connects through a 6 Gbps baseline network interface. CPU instruction sets include AVX and AVX-512 foundation support, though newer extensions like AVX-512 VNNI and AMX are not present on this processor generation.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate clear architectural trade-offs between the CPU and GPU capabilities. The Intel Xeon 8163 registers modest single-core throughput, reflected by a Geekbench single-core score of 937.0 and stress-ng single-core rating in the bottom 25%. However, multi-threaded CPU results remain steady in the average tier, with Geekbench multi-core at 5951.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 13056.17. In contrast, the dedicated NVIDIA T4 delivers competitive inference performance. It achieves 8410.67 tokens per second on prompt processing for 135M parameter models and 1141.42 tokens per second on 7B models, both falling into top-tier benchmark categories, alongside a strong 34.57 tokens per second for 7B text generation.

From an operational cost perspective, the instance is positioned as an entry-level GPU inference and accelerated compute node. The absence of integrated local NVMe storage requires external network block storage, which shifts baseline I/O performance to networked solutions. The 16 GB VRAM ceiling similarly restricts execution of large 70B parameter models, limiting utility for high-parameter deep learning architectures. Consequently, this instance offers balanced economic value primarily for workloads that require modest CPU capability combined with GPU offloading, such as medium-sized deep learning inference, image processing pipelines, video transcoding, and GPU-assisted analytics.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance featuring 16 vCPUs (8 physical cores) from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz, 62.0 GB of RAM, and a dedicated NVIDIA Turing T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. It includes no local storage and operates with a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Synthetic benchmarks indicate weak single-core CPU throughput, while multi-core metrics like Geekbench (5951.0) and PassMark CPU (13056.17) align with median server performance. The integrated NVIDIA T4 demonstrates strong capability in deep learning inference, reaching 1141.42 tokens per second in prompt processing and 34.57 tokens per second in text generation on 7B parameter models. Without local NVMe storage and with VRAM restricted to 16 GB, it is tailored for small to medium AI inference, image processing, and GPU-accelerated computing.
